name: @pipeworx/mcp-lyrics-ovh

tools.name: lyrics
tools.description: Exact-name lookup. Returns the lyrics text for an (artist, title) pair.

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Title/artist suggestions for a free-form query (results have track + artist info).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-lyrics-ovh forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the lyrics-ovh pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
